system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:38:18 UTC, kim.ortega logged on interactively (LogonType 10) to WS-RIYER-01 from 198.51.100.77; an inbound connection to that workstation's RDP port 3389 is also recorded.
The remote interactive logon is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is only performed from WS-KORTEGA-01 inside the office.
At 13:42:23 UTC, the domain controller recorded creation of support_tmp by kim.ortega; four seconds later, kim.ortega added it to a group labeled Administrators.

At 13:42:28 UTC, a scheduled task named SyncCheck was registered on WS-RIYER-01 under kim.ortega. Its action runs hidden PowerShell with an encoded command that decodes to a request for http://198.51.100.77/s.ps1 followed by IEX.
The unexpected account creation and administrative-group addition, together with a hidden PowerShell task configured to retrieve and execute a script, support a malicious-activity finding.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy access logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a forwarder outage, covering the task registration and scheduled account creation window.
The provided evidence does not include a task execution event or the retrieved script's contents.
claims_not_established: Whether the SyncCheck task actually ran or whether the script was retrieved and executed.
Whether support_tmp was subsequently used, and what access or activity it had.
The real-world origin or ownership of 198.51.100.77, or whether the address is sanitized in this evidence.
Whether any data was accessed, modified, or exfiltrated.
Whether the account creation or task had an approved request or change authorization.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and inspect WS-RIYER-01 for the SyncCheck task's execution history, PowerShell logs, downloaded files, and related process or network activity.
Recover proxy access logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC and check for requests to 198.51.100.77, including the requested script path.
Review DC-LV-01 audit records and current directory state to verify support_tmp's group membership, subsequent authentication, and any related account changes.
Correlate the account-creation event with its originating logon and determine whether the apparent kim.ortega activity was authorized or resulted from account compromise.
Validate the source address and investigate any related activity on WS-RIYER-01 and other hosts.
